text:
alex: brief follow-up on KV OOM prod-23. need owners/timelines for remediation: recurring slab fragmentation + sticky residency under burst writes.

jamie: i'll own profiling + GC knob experiments. plan: heap snapshots on 3 hot shards, jemalloc stats, run reproducer. initial artifacts in 72h.

ravi: i'll own eviction/limits. propose soft_limit=85% residency, graduated eviction with age bias, and incremental eviction on canary. will test tomorrow.

meera: i'll take fragmentation mitigation and compaction scheduling. prototype background slab compactor in low-qps window; need ~5d.

sre-bot: deploy event: canary/kv-canary-4 -> prod-candidate at 2026-03-24T02:15Z (paused).

alex: checklist for owners: 1) reproducible profile on ticket 2) perf regression test (p95) 3) rollout + rollback criteria 4) telemetry updates (residency, frag_ratio, GC pauses).

jamie: profiling commands:
```
pkill -USR1 $(pidof runtime) && curl -s http://metrics/heapdump > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pb
cat /proc/$(pidof runtime)/status; mallctl stats
```
will attach outputs to RF ticket.

ravi: eviction tuning: kv.residency.soft_limit=0.85, kv.eviction.age_bias=0.3, evict_incremental=true on canary. rollback if p99 > +20%.

meera: frag metric to add: "frag_ratio_v2" = useful_allocated_bytes / total_committed_bytes. alert if >0.35 for 30m. adding synthetic long-seq writer.

alex: consider temp throttle for large prefix writes.

jamie: recommend ingest.prefix_write_rate_limit=500/s on canary; coordinating with raven.

ravi: canary schedule: 2026-03-24T03:00Z start at 10% traffic, observe 6h, bump to 30% if stable. i'll own rollback.

meera: compaction prototype: batch 4 shards/node, window 02:00-05:00 local. will post config in RF-4394.

alex: risks: compaction CPU spike; eviction vs hot prefixes; embedding pipeline regressions. tag teams.

jamie: blocker: need jemalloc symbolized traces (cc infra-ops). pinged infra.

ravi: i'll post canary config + rollback in #release-war-room.

meera: target frag panel + synthetic by 2026-03-25 EOD.

alex: recap owners/times: jamie (profiling & GC knobs) 72h; ravi (limits & canary) canary 03/24; meera (frag & compaction) 5d. next check-in 2026-03-26 15:00 UTC. update tickets. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-26T15:00Z.

jamie: created RF-4392 and uploaded heap dump.

ravi: created RF-4393 for eviction/canary config.

meera: created RF-4394 for compaction prototype.

alex: owners please post daily short updates until remediation shipped.

jamie: day1: heap snapshots show allocations concentrated in arena 2; running jemalloc purge tests.

ravi: day1: canary at 10%, p95 steady; eviction churn slightly higher, monitoring.

meera: day1: compactor prototype ran, CPU +8% in window, frag down ~12% on test shard.

alex: thanks everyone. we'll fold notes into the postmortem follow-up doc and close RF tickets once rolled.
